notes.title: Final update
notes.content: We are very proud to announce that One Military Camp will finally be released on March 2nd as Early Access at a reduced price of $24.99/24.99 € on Steam, with an extra 10% discount on Steam during the first week.

- Other issues reported by the community has been fixed
